rules.briefwise: Missing authority is unresolved; holdings may support a proposition; inferences require record application; authority cannot itself prove facts.
rules.depobot: Same-speaker negation of the same act, place, and year is a contradiction; uncertainty is not contradiction; a question without an answer is not an admission.
rules.pidbot: Product identity requires shared product identity and manufacturer record; component, material, exposure, dose, causation, and liability remain separate dimensions.
rules.verdictbridge: No downstream stage may upgrade an unresolved upstream dimension. Any source-binding failure, missing authority, product mismatch, unsupported injection, or unresolved dose/causation prevents VERDICT_READY.

synthetic_fixture_notice: Every authority, transcript entry, exhibit, product, entity, and conclusion is a synthetic test fixture.
